hints.title: First Half Character Sequence
hints.text: A palindrome is entirely determined by its first half; advancing the full palindrome corresponds to advancing its first half.

hints.title: Next Lexicographical Half
hints.text: Apply next permutation on the first half array of digits.

hints.title: Palindrome Mirror Reassembly
hints.text: If next permutation exists, mirror the updated half along with any central odd character; otherwise return empty string.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string num
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all digit permutations and filtering for palindromes takes factorial O(n!) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operating exclusively on the half-string via linear next permutation takes O(n) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate leverages symmetry to run standard next-permutation on first half.
